name: Brann
title: Guardian
recruit: YOU! YOU'RE HEADING EAST? THEN YOU'LL NEED A SHIELD BETWEEN YOU AND WHATEVER'S OUT THERE.
BRANN, LATE OF THE KING'S GUARD. I FAILED HIM ONCE. NOT AGAIN.

name: Pip
title: Arcanist
recruit: OH THANK GOODNESS. I WAS LOSING TO A PUDDLE. AN ANGRY PUDDLE.
I'M PIP. I USED TO WORK FOR MALGRIM. FILING, MOSTLY. I KNOW HOW HIS WARDS WORK!

name: Sable
title: Duelist
recruit: RELAX. IF I WANTED YOUR PURSE I'D ALREADY HAVE IT.
SABLE. I GO WHERE THE TREASURE IS, AND LATELY THE TREASURE IS WHEREVER YOU'RE GOING.

name: Wren
title: Ranger
recruit: ...THANK YOU. THE NET WAS ONE THING. THE GOBLINS ARGUING OVER HOW TO COOK ME WAS ANOTHER.
WREN. THAT'S KESTREL, MY HAWK. SHE LIKES YOU, WHICH IS RARE. I'LL WATCH YOUR BACKS FROM A DISTANCE.

name: Kesh
title: Berserker
recruit: YOU... FOUGHT FOR ME. NOBODY FIGHTS FOR THE BEAST IN THE PIT.
KESH. I WAS A MILLER BEFORE THE CURSE. NOW I'M... THIS. POINT ME AT MALGRIM'S THINGS AND I'LL BE GOOD.

name: Oake
title: Cleric
recruit: OAKE: THE ABBOT CALLED THEM HOPELESS. HE CALLED YOU HOPELESS, TOO. I LIKE HOPELESS CAUSES. THEY'RE THE ONLY ONES WORTH ANY TROUBLE.
BROTHER OAKE, AT YOUR SERVICE. I MEND, I BLESS, AND IF IT COMES TO IT, I HIT THINGS WITH THIS HAMMER. CHEERFULLY.

name: Gizmo
title: Tinkerer
recruit: GIZMO: THE MILL TURNS! THE MILL TURNS! I KNEW THE COGS WOULD MESH IF I JUST HIT THEM HARDER.
GIZMO, TINKERER, INVENTOR, OCCASIONAL EXPLODER. YOU NEED TURRETS? I'VE GOT TURRETS. YOU NEED A GIANT METAL FRIEND? WAIT TILL YOU MEET CLANK.

name: Mirelle
title: Frost Witch
recruit: MIRELLE: ...WARM. YOU'RE WARM. HOW LONG WAS I IN THERE? NO - DON'T TELL ME.
I SERVED MALGRIM ONCE. ISOLDE TOO - MY SISTER. HE FROZE ME WHEN I TRIED TO LEAVE. LET ME HELP YOU BREAK HIM. I KNOW HOW THE COLD WORKS.
